proposal: Contract pieces ASM-28 and LRN-45 imply (D120; D72 standing approval to add spec-implied pieces and report after), proposed by M45.d. Each entry is a JSON Pointer into a contract under docs/specification/contracts and the value to add there. Until the specification adopts them the core sends and accepts them as written here (agent_core/api/assessment.py checks the reveal body itself; practice replies add `worked` only after a second miss), and client-core's practice controller checks `worked` against the adopted WorkedExampleView before accepting it. Once adopted, codegen picks them up and these allowances never apply.

additions.why: ASM-28: the worked answer, with its check or source, appears after the second attempt. A first miss keeps the question (next_item is the same item) and carries no worked answer; a second miss carries it and moves on. It is the adopted worked-example view: each step with its check and the final answer from the verified key with the key's check.

value.description: Present only when a second try on the question missed (ASM-28); never on a first miss.

additions.why: ASM-28: the worked answer also appears on Don't know or when the student asks to see it. Nothing is marked; the set moves on.

value.description: POST /v1/practice/sets/{set_id}/reveal: Don't know on the question shown.

additions.why: The reply to Don't know: the shown question's worked answer, its idea's band (unchanged: nothing was marked) and the next question.
The route for Don't know; auth launch + profile like the other practice routes; no student text (screened as ids only).

LRN-45: the learner can change the daily goal or hide the chip. NOT implemented in the core yet: it needs the same key in SettingsPatch, payload_setting_change.setting and the settings table's CHECK (data/schema.sql), an owner-visible storage change. Until then the client keeps the change for the open profile only (cleared on lock, SEC-19) and reads this key whenever a core sends it.

value.description: Study actions a day for the daily goal chip (LRN-45); 0 hides the chip.
